speaker: davy_gannet
text: Two pence to Whitehall, master, same as ever. The flood is at the last of it. The stairs are iron, and the poles will know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The last of it will do. Canon Row. I am not buying a story on the way.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Canon Row is a tide, master, not a story. Sit trim. I will put you up on what is left. I will not promise a boat home. Midnight is no water for this.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We know the midnight. Take us up. The walk home is not your fare.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Two pence, then. Mind the stairs. They are iron, and they mean it.
